records.speaker: Port Worker
records.Japanese:
おっ
あんたたち、琥珀（コハク）を
扱ってんのかい？
records.current_English: Oh! You deal in amber?

records.speaker: Charles Rochefort
records.Japanese:
ええ、そうですよ
…琥珀の輝きを見ていると
太古の時代に誘われるようですね
records.current_English:
We do. Looking at that glow
 makes me feel like I'm back
 in the ancient world.

records.speaker: Port Worker
records.Japanese: んん？　何言ってんだ？
records.current_English: Huh? What's that supposed to mean?

records.speaker: Charles Rochefort
records.Japanese:
琥珀というのは大昔の樹液が固まって
宝石として生まれ変わった
ものなんですよ
records.current_English:
Amber is sap from an ancient tree. 
 It hardened and became a gemstone.

records.speaker: Charles Rochefort
records.Japanese:
ほら、この琥珀の中に蜂が見える
でしょう？　この蜂は何千年もの間
セピア色をした小宇宙の中で
眠っているのです。神秘的ですねえ…
records.current_English:
See the bee in there?
 It's been asleep for thousands 
 of years in its own little sepia 
 world. Isn't that mysterious?

records.speaker: Port Worker
records.Japanese:
はあ？　兄ちゃん、なんで
そんな小難しいこと知ってんだよ
records.current_English:
How come you know all that fancy 
 stuff, kid?

records.speaker: Charles Rochefort
records.Japanese:
科学の力です。科学というものは
人智を越えたこの世の奇跡を
人智によって少しでも解き明かそうと
する学問なんですよ
records.current_English:
Science! We use what we know to try
 to make a little sense of miracles 
 beyond our understanding.

records.speaker: Port Worker
records.Japanese:
？？？　何だかさっぱり分かんねえや
…おっ、そうだ
琥珀といや思い出したことがある
records.current_English:
I didn't get a word of that. Oh, 
 wait. Speaking of amber, I just
 remembered something.

records.speaker: Charles Rochefort
records.Japanese: 何ですか？
records.current_English: What?

records.speaker: Port Worker
records.Japanese:
この岬の沖に、島がいくつかあるんだが
聞いたところによるとその島の中に
琥珀色に輝く不思議な場所が
あるって話だ
records.current_English:
There are a few islands off
 this cape. I hear there's a strange
 place on one of them that gives off
 an amber glow.

records.speaker: Charles Rochefort
records.Japanese: 琥珀色に？　鉱脈か何かかな？
records.current_English:
An amber glow? 
 Could it be a vein of ore?

records.speaker: Port Worker
records.Japanese:
さあね。それが何かってことまでは
分かんねえよ
ま、あくまで噂だしな
records.current_English:
Couldn't tell you what it is. It's 
 only a rumor, anyway.

records.speaker: Charles Rochefort
records.Japanese:
ふーん、そうですか
わざわざ教えてくれてありがとう
私の科学的好奇心に訴える情報ですよ
records.current_English:
I see. Thanks for the tip. 
 Now you've piqued
 my scientific curiosity!

rows: Couldn't tell you what it is. It's

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.Japanese: ふぅ…
records.current_English: (Sigh...)

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: どうしたの、フリオさん？
records.current_English: What's on your mind, Julio?

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.Japanese: いや、孫のことが心配でな
records.current_English:
Oh, I'm worried about
 my granddaughter.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: クリスティナのことだね
records.current_English: Cristina, you mean.

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.Japanese:
ちゃんとやっておるか、気になるのじゃ
親バカ、いや爺バカと笑うてくれい
records.current_English:
I just wonder how she's getting
 on. Call me a doting father... 
 grandfather, I should say.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
クリスティナなら大丈夫だよ、きっと
アテナの生まれ変わりみたいに
強いからね
records.current_English:
Cristina will be fine. She's 
 as strong as if Athena herself 
 had come back to life.

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.Japanese: アテナ？
records.current_English: Athena?

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
ギリシア神話の女神だよ。ローマ神話
ではミネルヴァって呼ばれてるよ
records.current_English:
A goddess from Greek myth. 
 The Romans call her Minerva.

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.Japanese:
むかーしに、聞いたような気もするが
神さんの話ってのはよう知らんのじゃ
records.current_English:
I might've heard of her long ago.
 I never did know much about
 the gods.

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.Japanese:
…しかし、そのミネ何とかってのは
聞いたような気がするな
records.current_English:
...Still, that Miner-whatever
 sounds familiar.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
とにかく、クリスティナなら
大丈夫だよ
records.current_English:
Anyway, I'm sure 
 Cristina will be all right.

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.Japanese:
…ありがたいのう
クリスティナは提督に信頼されておるの
じゃな。だが、わしにはただの孫娘じゃ
年寄りの気持ちも分かってくれ
records.current_English:
It means a lot that you trust
 her so much. But to me,
 she's my granddaughter. An old man 
 worries, you know.

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.Japanese:
…おお！
そうじゃ、思い出した！
records.current_English: ...Oh! Now I remember!

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.current_English: Hm?

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.Japanese:
そうじゃ、そうじゃ、たーしか
『ミネルヴァの盾』とか言うとったぞ
records.current_English:
That's it. The Minerva Shield, 
 I think it was called.

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.Japanese:
地中海じゃったか、黒海じゃったか…
その辺りに眠っとると噂になった
伝説の防具じゃ。今までは
本気で探しはしなかったが…
records.current_English:
Was it the Mediterranean 
 or the Black Sea? They say there's 
 legendary armor hidden there.
 I never looked in earnest, but...

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.Japanese:
クリスティナがミネルヴァのようだと
聞いたらすごく手に入れたくなったわい
本当にあるんならクリスティナに
持たせてやりたいのう…
records.current_English:
Now that you've likened Cristina 
 to Minerva, I want to find it. 
 If it really exists, I'd like
 her to have it.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: フリオさん…
records.current_English: Julio...

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.Japanese:
くだらん話をして悪かったの
爺のたわ言だと思うて、忘れてくれい
さ、そろそろ仕事に戻らんとな
records.current_English:
Forgive an old man for rambling. 
 Best forget it. I'd better get 
 back to work.

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.Japanese: ほれ、提督も仕事をせんと
records.current_English: Back to work for you too, Admiral.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: うん、そうだね
records.current_English: Right.

rows: as strong as if Athena herself
or the Black Sea? They say there's
I never looked in earnest, but...

records.speaker: Samwell Khan
records.Japanese: 提督、ちょっといい？
records.current_English: Admiral, got a minute?

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: どうしたの？
records.current_English: What is it?

records.speaker: Samwell Khan
records.Japanese:
孔雀っていう、世にも美しい鳥が
いるんだけどさ、見てみたいよね
records.current_English:
Ever seen a peacock? They're some
 of the most beautiful birds
 in the world. Wouldn't you like
 to see one?

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
急に何を…
あっ、また、なんかの噂を聞いて
きたんだね？
records.current_English:
Well, that's out of the blue...
 Oh, you've heard another rumor,
 haven't you?

records.speaker: Samwell Khan
records.Japanese:
実はそうなんだよね
『孔雀かたびら』っていうんだけど
records.current_English:
You guessed it. It's something 
 called Peacock Mail.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
孔雀って鳥の羽でも使った
かたびらなの？
records.current_English: Armor made from peacock feathers?

records.speaker: Samwell Khan
records.Japanese:
惜しーーい！　すごく惜しいよ
実はね、孔雀の尾羽を背に付けた
かたびらなんだ
records.current_English:
Close! You're really close! It's 
 mail with peacock tail feathers
 fastened to the back.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: あんまり強そうじゃないなあ
records.current_English: Doesn't sound like much protection.

records.speaker: Samwell Khan
records.Japanese:
でも、見た目に圧倒されて
敵が思わず立ちすくむんだって
それが最大の効果らしいよ
records.current_English:
Just the sight of it stops enemies 
 in their tracks, or so they say. 
 That's the main thing it does.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
うーん…本当に役に立つのかなあ
で、それは、どこにあるの？
records.current_English:
Hmm... Would that really help? 
 Well, where are we supposed
 to find it?

records.speaker: Samwell Khan
records.Japanese:
喜望峰をずうーと、ずうーと、ずうーと
東南に行った小島に在るらしいんだ
それしか分からなかったんだ
records.current_English:
I hear it's on a little island 
 way, way, way southeast
 of the Cape of Good Hope. That's 
 all I found out.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
それだけじゃ本当に
見当がつかないな
records.current_English: That hardly narrows it down.

records.speaker: Samwell Khan
records.Japanese:
でも、見てみたいなあ
きっと、見たこともないような
すごいものなんだろうなあ
records.current_English:
But I still want to see it! I bet
 it's unlike anything I've
 ever seen.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
そう
とにかく気には留めておくよ
期待しないでね
records.current_English:
All right, I'll keep it in mind. 
 No promises.

records.speaker: Samwell Khan
records.Japanese: 分かってるって
records.current_English: I know, I know.

rows: I hear it's on a little island
of the Cape of Good Hope. That's

records.speaker: Samwell Khan
records.Japanese: 提督、ちょっといい？
records.current_English: Admiral, got a minute?

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: どうしたの？
records.current_English: What is it?

records.speaker: Samwell Khan
records.Japanese: 『ジャガー神の宿る胴着』を探そうよ
records.current_English:
Let's look for the 
 Jaguar God's Vest.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: 何、それ？
records.current_English: What's that?

records.speaker: Samwell Khan
records.Japanese:
その名の通り
ジャガー神が宿るとされている胴着だよ
新大陸にあるらしいんだ
records.current_English:
Just what it sounds like. They say 
 the jaguar god lives in it.
 I hear it's in the New World.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
また、新しい噂を
聞いてきたんだね
records.current_English: So you've heard another rumor.

records.speaker: Samwell Khan
records.Japanese:
うん
でも、これで最後だよ
records.current_English: Yeah, but this is my last one.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: 最後って？
records.current_English: The last one?

records.speaker: Samwell Khan
records.Japanese:
場所を調べるのが結構大変なんだよね
もう、飽きちゃったし
records.current_English:
Tracking down where these things 
 are is pretty hard.
 I'm bored with it anyway.

records.speaker: Samwell Khan
records.Japanese:
僕の興味、長く続かないんだよね
動物は好きだけど、料理できなきゃ
つまんないや。あ、もちろん
偶然聞いたら教えてあげるよ
records.current_English:
I get bored fast. I like animals,
 but if I can't cook 'em, 
 what's the fun? I'll pass along any
 rumors I happen to hear.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
そ、そう。じゃあ胴着の話に戻るけど
新大陸のどこにあるのか
分からないの？
records.current_English:
R-right. About the vest, then. Any 
 idea where in the New World
 it might be?

records.speaker: Samwell Khan
records.Japanese:
うーん
新大陸の西側じゃないかな
records.current_English:
Hmm... I'd guess the western side
 of the New World.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
広すぎるよ
もう少し、限定できない？
records.current_English:
That's a huge area.
 Can't you narrow it down?

records.speaker: Samwell Khan
records.Japanese:
ごめんね
これ以上は分からなかったんだ
だから、気には留めておくことに
しといてよ
records.current_English:
Sorry, that's all I could find out.
 Just keep it in mind, okay?

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: ははっ。そうするよ
records.current_English: Heh. All right, I will.

records.speaker: Janus Pasar
records.Japanese:
提督、この辺りでポルトガルの船団が
２０年ほど前に遭難したって話
知ってます？
records.current_English:
Admiral, have you heard about
 a Portuguese fleet that was wrecked
 near here about twenty years ago?

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: 初めて聞いたよ
records.current_English: That's news to me.

records.speaker: Janus Pasar
records.Japanese:
いや、その提督が、すっごく遠くまで
見通せる望遠鏡を持っていた
らしんですよ。何でも、月の
凹凸までも鮮明に見えたとか何とか
records.current_English:
The admiral had a telescope
 that could see for miles,
 they say. You could even see 
 bumps and hollows on the moon.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: へえ！　それはすごいね！
records.current_English: Really? That's incredible!

records.speaker: Janus Pasar
records.Japanese:
ヘレニズム時代の天才的な天文学者
アリスタルコスが制作したと
いわれてますが…
records.current_English:
They say Aristarchus made
 it, the brilliant astronomer 
 from the Hellenistic age.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: …本当？
records.current_English: ...Really?

records.speaker: Janus Pasar
records.Japanese:
そんな時代に、レンズをそこまで
精密に磨く技術があったとは
考えにくいですけどね
records.current_English:
I find it hard to believe
 they could polish lenses 
 that precisely in those days.

records.speaker: Janus Pasar
records.Japanese:
真偽のほどは分かりません。とにかく
彼の名を冠して
『アリスタルコスの望遠鏡』
と呼ばれてたそうですよ
records.current_English:
I can't tell you if it's true. 
 In any case, they called it the
 Aristarchus Telescope, after him.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: それで？
records.current_English: What about it?

records.speaker: Janus Pasar
records.Japanese:
海流から考えて、その望遠鏡が
この辺りの海岸に打ち上げられている
可能性が高いんじゃないかと
思ったんです
records.current_English:
Given the currents, I think there's
 a good chance the telescope
 washed ashore somewhere
 around here.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
なるほど！
それは探してみる価値がありそうだね
records.current_English:
I see! Sounds like it's
 worth looking for.

rows: Given the currents, I think there's

records.speaker: Emilio Ferog
records.Japanese:
港に着いたんだから
早くなんか食べに行こ
records.current_English:
We're in port! Come on, let's get
 something to eat!

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
エミリオは港に着くと
いつも『早くなんか食べに行こ』って
言ってるね
records.current_English:
You say that every time we dock, 
 Emilio. 'Come on, let's get
 something to eat!'

records.speaker: Emilio Ferog
records.Japanese:
だって、食べるってことは
とっても大事なことなんだよ
それに、探している物もあるし
records.current_English:
Eating's really important, 
 you know! And I'm looking
 for something, too.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: 探している物って何？
records.current_English: What are you looking for?

records.speaker: Emilio Ferog
records.Japanese: 世界一おいしい食べ物！
records.current_English: The world's best food!

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
…
世界一おいしいかどうか
どうやって判断するの？
records.current_English:
...How will you know it's
 the best food in the world?

records.speaker: Emilio Ferog
records.Japanese:
だいじょーぶ。分かるんだ
世界でいちばんおいしい食べ物は
『ヘスティアの釜』で作った
料理なんだ
records.current_English:
Oh, I'll know! The best food in the
 world is cooked in Hestia's Pot.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: ヘスティアの…釜？
records.current_English: Hestia's... Pot?

records.speaker: Emilio Ferog
records.Japanese:
炉の女神さまがつくらせたっていう
釜だよ。ギリシャの南の方、ずっと
海の向こうにあるって
聞いたんだよね
records.current_English:
The goddess of the hearth
 had it made, or so they say. 
 I hear it's far across the sea,
 south of Greece.

records.speaker: Emilio Ferog
records.Japanese:
だから、ギリシャの辺りの食べ物屋さん
に行くのがとっても楽しみなんだ
もういいでしょ、早くなんか
食べに行こうよ
records.current_English:
That's why I can't wait to eat 
 around Greece. Now,
 can we go? Come on, let's get
 something to eat!

rows: the best food in the world?

records.speaker: Yukihisa Shiraki
records.Japanese:
提督、とうとう妖刀村正を
発見なされたそうですな
私もひと目、拝見させていただければと
思うのですが
records.current_English:
Admiral, I hear you've finally 
 found the cursed blade Muramasa. 
 Might I see it for myself?

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
もちろん構わないよ
ユキヒサの報告のおかげで
見つけることができたんだから
records.current_English:
Of course. We found
 it thanks to your tip, Yukihisa.

records.speaker: Yukihisa Shiraki
records.Japanese: これが…これが『妖刀村正』…
records.current_English:
So this... this is the 
 cursed blade Muramasa...

records.speaker: Yukihisa Shiraki
records.Japanese:
うーむ…
まるで吸い込まれそうな
妖しい光を放っておりますな
records.current_English:
Hmm... That strange glow almost
 draws you in, doesn't it?

records.speaker: Yukihisa Shiraki
records.Japanese: 眼福にござった
records.current_English: I'm glad I had the chance to see it.

rows: it thanks to your tip, Yukihisa.

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.Japanese: すげえ古そうな遺跡だったな
records.current_English: Those ruins must be ancient.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
それにしても、奴らは何者なんだろう
生け贄なんてかなり野蛮だよ…
records.current_English:
Who were those people, anyway? 
 Offering up a living sacrifice 
 like that...

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.Japanese:
あいつら、絶対、まともじゃねえよ！
だが…
またここに集まるって言ってたな
records.current_English:
Those people are out 
 of their minds! But... they said 
 they'd meet here again, right?

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
彼ら、いったい何を
するつもりなんだろう？
records.current_English: What are they planning?

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.Japanese:
さあな
そういや、『お告げの日の前夜』と
か言ってたな
それっていつなんだ？
records.current_English:
Beats me. They said something
 about 'the night before
 the day of revelation.' When's 
 that supposed to be?

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
…ほら、あのおまじないの文句
『光と闇が拮抗するとき』っていうのが
その日のことなんじゃない？
records.current_English:
Remember the incantation?
 'When light and darkness 
 are evenly matched.' 
 Could that be the day they meant?

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.Japanese:
はあ？
それだけじゃさっぱり分かんねえぞ
records.current_English: Huh? That doesn't tell me a thing.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
とにかく、何か手を考えよう
生け贄なんて、やめさせなきゃ！
records.current_English:
We need a plan.
 We have to stop them from making 
 any more sacrifices!

records.speaker: Sect Leader
records.Japanese: あああ～～～…
records.current_English: Aaaah...

records.speaker: Follower
records.Japanese: おおお～～～！
records.current_English: Ooooh!

records.speaker: Sect Leader
records.Japanese:
これは、お告げなのだ！
我々『古代巨石文明研究会』は
近く、世界を制圧するであろう！
records.current_English:
This is a divine revelation! 
 We, the Ancient Megalithic 
 Civilization Research Society, 
 shall soon conquer the world!

records.speaker: Sect Leader
records.Japanese:
我々は選ばれし者！
ここに書かれた宝物を掘り出し
神をもおそれぬ愚民どもを
支配するのだ！！
records.current_English:
We are the chosen ones! We shall 
 dig up the treasure described here 
 and rule over those godless fools!

records.speaker: Follower
records.Japanese: おおーっ！
records.current_English: Ooooh!

records.speaker: Sect Leader
records.Japanese:
まず手始めに、この村を襲う！
我々をばかにした連中に
思い知らせてやるのだ！
records.current_English:
First, we attack this village! 
 We'll teach those who mocked us
 a lesson!

records.speaker: Follower
records.Japanese: おおおーっ！！
records.current_English: Ooooh!

rows: of their minds! But... they said

records.speaker: Villager
records.Japanese:
あんたらは？
！！　もしや…
records.current_English: Who are you? Wait, could it be...?

records.speaker: Villager
records.Japanese:
おお！
久しぶりに同教徒に出会った！
records.current_English:
Oh! It's been so long since we met 
 someone who shares our faith!

records.speaker: Villager
records.Japanese:
我々はイスラム勢力の支配を逃れ
信仰をつらぬいてひっそりと
暮らしてきた者です
records.current_English:
We fled Muslim rule and have lived 
 quietly here ever since, 
 keeping our faith.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
あの、つかぬことをお聞きしますが
７つの海を制覇した者が手にするという
宝物の話をご存じでしょうか？
records.current_English:
Forgive the sudden question, but do
 you know of a treasure that goes 
 to whoever conquers the seven seas?

records.speaker: Villager
records.Japanese:
なんと！！
『覇者の証』をお探しですか？
…神のお導きだ！
records.current_English:
What! You're looking 
 for the Proof of Conquest? God 
 must have brought you here!

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
えっ？
何かご存じですか？
records.current_English: You... know something about it?

records.speaker: Villager
records.Japanese: 知っているも何も…
records.current_English: Do I ever...

records.speaker: Villager
records.Japanese:
この里に古来から伝わるランプです
『証』を求める者が、必ず必要とすると
いわれています。これを
あなた方に託しましょう
records.current_English:
This lamp has been in our village
 for generations. They say anyone 
 who seeks the Proof will need it.
 I'm entrusting it to you.

records.speaker: Villager
records.Japanese:
…お願いです
『証』がオスマン帝国の手に渡らぬよう
なんとかあなた方のお力で…
records.current_English:
Please... Do what you can to keep
 the Proof out
 of the Ottoman Empire's hands.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
分かりました
きっと見つけてみせます
records.current_English:
I understand.
 We'll find it, I promise.

rows: for the Proof of Conquest? God

records.speaker: FE temple/Colosseum presenter
records.Japanese:
“コロッセウム”の訪問者よ
我が問いに答えよ！
records.current_English:
Visitor to the Colosseum,
 answer my question!

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: 問い…？
records.current_English: A question...?

records.speaker: FE temple/Colosseum presenter
records.Japanese: では問う
records.current_English: Then hear my question.

records.speaker: FE temple/Colosseum presenter
records.Japanese:
我は不思議な豆を持っている
この豆は、１秒経つと２つに分かれる
２秒後には４つ、３秒後には８つになる
records.current_English:
I have a strange bean. 
 In one second it splits in two,
 then there are four at two seconds 
 and eight at three seconds.

records.speaker: FE temple/Colosseum presenter
records.Japanese:
この豆を袋に１つ入れると
６０秒後には袋がいっぱいになる。では
始めに２つ入れると袋がいっぱいに
なるのは何秒後か？
records.current_English:
Start with one bean and the bag is 
 full after 60 seconds. If you start
 with two beans, how many seconds 
 will it take?

records.speaker: FE temple/Colosseum presenter
records.Japanese: さあ次なる中より答えを選べ！
records.current_English: Choose an answer!

records.speaker: Player choice
records.Japanese: １秒
records.current_English: 1 second

records.speaker: Player choice
records.current_English: 30 seconds

records.speaker: Player choice
records.current_English: 59 seconds

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.Japanese: …分かった！
records.current_English: ...Got it!

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
本当に？
さすがクラウ、いざってときは
頼りになるね！
records.current_English:
Really? I can always count on
 you when it matters, Clau!

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.Japanese:
おおよ！　答えは『１秒』だ！
どうだ！
records.current_English: You bet! One second. How's that?

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
そうだね！
僕もそうかなって思ったんだ！
records.current_English:
Yeah! That's 
 what I was thinking, too!

records.speaker: FE temple/Colosseum presenter
records.Japanese: 愚か者め！
records.current_English: Fool!

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.current_English: Huh?

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.Japanese: …分かった！
records.current_English: ...Got it!

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
本当に？
さすがクラウ、いざってときは
頼りになるね！
records.current_English:
Really? I can always count on
 you when it matters, Clau!

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.Japanese:
おおよ！　答えは半分の『３０秒』だ！
どうだ！
records.current_English:
Sure! Half the time. 
 Thirty seconds! How's that?

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
そうだね！
僕もそうかなって思ったんだ！
records.current_English:
Yeah! That's 
 what I was thinking, too!

records.speaker: FE temple/Colosseum presenter
records.Japanese: 愚か者め！
records.current_English: Fool!

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.current_English: Huh?

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: …分かった！
records.current_English: ...Got it!

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.Japanese: おお？　で、答えは？
records.current_English: Oh yeah? What's the answer?

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: うん、答えは『５９秒』だよ！
records.current_English: It's 59 seconds!

records.speaker: FE temple/Colosseum presenter
records.Japanese:
見事だ！
知恵と勇気を持つ者よ！
これを授けようぞ！
records.current_English:
Well done! You have
 wisdom and courage. Accept this!

records.speaker: Senior Monk
records.Japanese: もし
records.current_English: Excuse me.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
え？
…何か？
records.current_English: Hm? Can I help you?

records.speaker: Senior Monk
records.Japanese:
そなた、『覇者の証』なる宝物を
探し求めておるな？
records.current_English: You seek the Proof of Conquest?

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
！！
どうしてそれを？
records.current_English: How did you know?

records.speaker: Hans Letzel
records.Japanese:
あなたは、『証』の地図について
何かご存じの様子じゃのう
records.current_English:
You seem to know something about 
 the map to the Proof.

records.speaker: Senior Monk
records.Japanese:
いかにも…。しかし
誰にでもお教えできるものでは
ござりませぬぞ
records.current_English:
Indeed. But that is something
 I cannot tell just anyone.

records.speaker: Hans Letzel
records.Japanese:
邪悪なる心を持つ者が
それを手にしたときのことを
恐れておられるのじゃな？
records.current_English:
You fear what someone
 with evil intentions 
 might do with it?

records.speaker: Senior Monk
records.Japanese: …左様
records.current_English: ...Yes.

records.speaker: Hans Letzel
records.Japanese:
心配はご無用じゃ
私は長年の間
『証』について研究してまいった
records.current_English:
You can put your mind at ease. I've
 studied the Proof for many years.

records.speaker: Hans Letzel
records.Japanese:
この少年こそ、間違いなく
覇者の資格を持つ者と
確信しておりますぞ
records.current_English:
I am certain this young man
 has what it takes to rule the seas.

records.speaker: Senior Monk
records.Japanese: ふうむ…
records.current_English: Hmm...

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
お願いします
ご存じでしたら、どうか教えてください
records.current_English:
Please. If you know
 something, tell us.

records.speaker: Senior Monk
records.Japanese: …よかろう
records.current_English: ...Very well.

records.speaker: Senior Monk
records.Japanese:
その昔、中華の地において
地図を守ってきた一族は、時の権力者の
追跡を逃れ、はるか、はるか北東の地に
向かったという
records.current_English:
Long ago, a clan guarded the map 
 in China. They say the ruler 
 pursued them, so they fled 
 far, far to the northeast.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: はるか北東…ですか
records.current_English: Far to the northeast...?

records.speaker: Senior Monk
records.Japanese:
北の果て、氷の海近くの小さき村に
たどり着いた一族の子孫は
そこで今もひっそりと暮らして
おるはずじゃ
records.current_English:
They reached a small village 
 in the far north, near an icy sea. 
 Their descendants should still 
 be living quietly there.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: …中国のずっと北東の村、か
records.current_English: ...A village far northeast of China.

records.speaker: Senior Monk
records.Japanese:
巨大な半島の付け根
東岸の高き峰のふもとを探すがよい
records.current_English:
Look near the base of
 the vast peninsula, at the foot of 
 a tall peak on its eastern coast.

records.speaker: Senior Monk
records.Japanese:
あまりにも遠き地ゆえ、普通の船では
たどり着くことは難しいかもしれぬ
生半可な気持ちでは、そなたらの命は
ないぞ
records.current_English:
An ordinary ship may struggle
 to reach a place that far
 away. Go unprepared, and it'll 
 cost you your lives.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: （…ごくっ。）
records.current_English: (...Gulp.)

records.speaker: Senior Monk
records.Japanese:
よいか。決して邪心を持つ者に
『証』を渡してはならぬ
そなたも邪悪な欲望に囚われるで
ないぞ
records.current_English:
Listen well. Never hand the Proof
 to anyone with evil intentions.
 Don't let greed
 get the better of you, either.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
はい！
ありがとうございました
records.current_English: I will. Thank you for telling us.

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.Japanese:
さて、FIや
航海中にできることが、あといくつか
あるんじゃが、それについて説明して
おこうかの
records.current_English:
There's more you can do at sea.
 Want to see how, FI?

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: はい。お願いします
records.current_English: Yes, please.

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.Japanese:
帆を全開にする、停泊する
それぞれの有効な場合についてじゃ
records.current_English:
I'll explain when to set full sail 
 and when to anchor.

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.Japanese:
『全開』は、船を最大速度で走らせる
時に使う。ただしこの場合は
艦長であるおぬしが操帆手に直接指示を
出してやる必要がある
records.current_English:
Full sail gives you top speed. 
 As captain, you'll have to 
 direct the Sail Handlers yourself.

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.Japanese:
まあ、慣れぬうちは『半開』のままで
よかろう。マストの数だけ操帆手を
配置しておけば、帆の操作を勝手に
やってくれるからの
records.current_English:
Half sail is fine while you learn. 
 Put a Sail Handler on each mast
 and they'll trim the sails for you.

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.Japanese:
『全開』では、船の速度が速すぎて
操作しにくいかもしれん
戦闘中も、『半開』の方が便利かも
しれんな
records.current_English:
At full sail, the ship may be too
 fast to handle easily. Half sail 
 can be more useful in battle, too.

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.Japanese:
また『停泊』は、隊列の広がった艦隊を
ひとまとめにしたり、敵を待ち伏せたり
といろいろな使い道が考えられる

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: なるほど
records.current_English: Got it.

records.speaker: System
records.Japanese:
洋上では、帆の開き具合で
速度を上げたり落としたりできます
また、その場で停泊もできます
records.current_English:
At sea, the sails set your speed.
 Drop anchor to stop in place.

records.speaker: System
records.Japanese:
帆の開きはＡボタン・Ｂボタンで
操作します。速度を下げるときは
Ｂボタン、上げるときはＡボタンです
records.current_English:
Use A and B to adjust the sails. 
 B slows you down. A speeds you up.

records.speaker: System
records.Japanese:
『全開』のときにＢボタンを押すと
『半開』になり、速度が下がります
records.current_English:
At full sail, press B
 to slow to half sail.

records.speaker: System
records.Japanese:
『半開』のときにＢボタンを押すと
『停泊』になり、その場で停止します
records.current_English:
Press B at half sail 
 to anchor and stop in place.

records.speaker: System
records.Japanese:
『停泊』中にＡボタンを押すと
『半開』に、『半開』中にＡボタンを
押すと『全開』になります
records.current_English:
At anchor, press A for half sail.
 Press A again to go to full sail.

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.Japanese:
注意すべきは、たとえ帆が『半開』で
あっても、帆手が足りねば、やはり
おぬしが帆の操作を指示してやらねば
ならんということじゃ
records.current_English:
Even at half sail, 
 you have to direct the sails 
 if you're short on Sail Handlers.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: え？　そうなんですか？
records.current_English: Really?

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.Japanese:
いずれ、全速航行が必要なときは
必ず来るわけじゃし、艦長たるもの
帆の操作くらいできるようにならんとな
records.current_English:
You'll need to sail at full speed
 eventually. A captain ought to know
 how to handle the sails.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: は、はい！
records.current_English: Y-yes!

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.Japanese:
船に速度を与える基本は
帆の後ろに風を受けることじゃ
records.current_English:
For speed, you want the wind 
 to catch the back of the sails.

records.speaker: System
records.Japanese:
帆の向きは、Ｌ、Ｒボタンで
決めます。帆を調整すると
船の速度が上がります
records.current_English:
Turn the sails with L and R. 
 Trim them well to pick up speed.

records.speaker: System
records.Japanese:
帆を左に回すときは、Ｌボタンを
右に回すときは、Ｒボタンを
押してください
records.current_English:
Press L to turn the sails left.
 Press R to turn them right.

records.speaker: System
records.Japanese:
タッチペンの場合は自動的に帆が
最適な方向になります
停止したい場合旗艦を押してください
records.current_English:
The stylus sets the best angle.
 Touch the flagship to stop.

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.Japanese:
風の向きに注意しながら
船の方向から見て、帆の後ろ側に
風が入るように操作するのじゃ
records.current_English:
Watch the wind and your heading. 
 Trim the sails so the wind catches 
 them from behind.

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.Japanese:
追い風ならばわりと簡単じゃが
向かい風のときはちょっとコツが
いるぞい
records.current_English:
A tailwind makes it fairly easy. 
 A headwind takes some skill.

records.speaker: System
records.Japanese:
速度は画面上のスピードメーターで
確認できます。速度を上げるなら
バーが最も長くなるように
調節しましょう
records.current_English:
Watch the on-screen speed gauge. 
 Trim for the longest possible bar.

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.Japanese:
さて、ひと通りのことは教えたかのう
あとは、おまえさんの研究次第じゃな
records.current_English:
Well, that covers the basics.
 The rest is up to you to work out.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
分かりました
やってみます！！
records.current_English: Got it. I'll give it a try!

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.Japanese:
ふーむ
なんか忘れておるような気がするのう…
records.current_English:
Hmm... I feel as though I've 
 forgotten something...

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.Japanese:
おお！　そうじゃ
FIや。すまんが
アテネに向かってくれんかね
records.current_English:
Oh, that's right! FI, 
 could you take us to Athens?

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
アテネ…ですか？
えーっと、ギリシアですね
地中海の東寄りあたりかな
records.current_English:
Athens...? Um, in Greece, right? 
 Toward the eastern Mediterranean?

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.Japanese:
そうじゃ
ちょいと用があるんじゃよ
records.current_English: Right. I've got a small errand.

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.Japanese:
よお。じいさんの用事なんかで
行き先を決めちまっていいのか？
records.current_English:
Wait. We're changing course
 for Julio's errand now?

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.Japanese:
わしだけの用事、というわけではない
これからのわしら、みんなに関する
ことを調べにゆくんじゃよ
records.current_English:
It's everyone's business. There's
 something I want to look into
 that'll matter to all of us later.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
『これからのみんなに関すること』…
…？
僕たちの目標、みたいなものですか？
records.current_English:
Something that'll matter to all
 of us... You mean like 
 a goal for the crew?

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.Japanese:
ふむ
まあ、そんなところじゃな
records.current_English: Yes. Something like that.

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.Japanese:
すぐにどうこうするということではない
だが、この先きっと必要になることじゃ
records.current_English:
No rush for now. 
 We'll need it later, though.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
アテネに行けば
それが分かるんですね？
records.current_English: So we'll find out in Athens?

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.Japanese: そうじゃよ
records.current_English: Yes.

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.Japanese:
ハイレディンとの約束を果たすためにも
必要なことなんじゃ
records.current_English:
We also need it to fulfill 
 our promise to Hayreddin.

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.Japanese:
へー！
FI、なんだか
面白そうだな！
records.current_English:
Oh, FI! 
 This sounds interesting!

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: うん！
records.current_English: Yeah!

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.Japanese:
善は急げじゃ
頼んだよ、FI
records.current_English:
FI, let's 
 not waste any time.
 I'm counting on you.

records.speaker: Janus Pasar
records.Japanese: 何があるんでしょうかね
records.current_English: What could be there?

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.Japanese:
よし！
“目標探し”に出発！
records.current_English: All right! Let's go find a goal!

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
？？
変なの…
records.current_English: Huh? That's an odd way to put it...

rows: you have to direct the sails
if you're short on Sail Handlers.
something I want to look into
that'll matter to all of us later.

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.Japanese: そういえば…
records.current_English: Oh, that reminds me...

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.Japanese:
うむうむ。そうじゃ、そうじゃ
クリスティナを連れていこう
records.current_English:
Yes, of course.
 We should bring Cristina along.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: 誰のことですか？
records.current_English: Who's Cristina?

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.Japanese:
わしの孫娘じゃ。剣をたしなんでおる
なかなかの使い手じゃぞ
records.current_English:
My granddaughter. She's quite good 
 with a sword, you know.

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.Japanese:
何だよ、女か！？
航海は男のロマン、俺は反対だね
ただでさえ、女が…
あわわ、いけねっ
records.current_English:
A woman?! Sailing's a man's
 adventure. No way. We've 
 already got a woman... Oops!

records.speaker: Arcadius Eudoxios
records.Japanese: コホン、クラウ…
records.current_English: Ahem. Clau...

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.Japanese:
な、何はともあれ
女はまずいだろう？
records.current_English:
A-anyway, having a woman aboard
 is a bad idea, right?

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
僕はいいと思うけどな
それに剣士なんでしょ
きっと力になってくれそうだよ
records.current_English:
I think it's a good idea. If she's 
 that good with a sword, she'll 
 be a help.

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.Japanese:
いいや、俺は反対だ！
いててて、な、何すんだ！
records.current_English:
No, I still say no! Ow, ow!
 Wh-what are you doing?

records.speaker: Arcadius Eudoxios
records.Japanese: （…１人も２人も同じでしょ？）
records.current_English:
(What's the difference 
 between one and two?)

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
（そうだよ。きっと他の女の人が
　いたほうが、アルカディウスも
　気が楽だし。）
records.current_English:
(Right. You'd probably feel
 more at ease with
 another woman around, Arcadius.)

records.speaker: Arcadius Eudoxios
records.Japanese: コホン。私も賛成だな
records.current_English:
Ahem. I think
 we should bring her, too.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
女の人もいた方が旅は楽しいよ
いいだろ、クラウ？
records.current_English:
It'd make the trip more fun
 to have women aboard.
 What do you say, Clau?

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.Japanese:
（何だよ
　FIまで…
　もう、分かったよ。）
records.current_English:
(You too, FI? 
 All right, fine.)

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.Japanese:
おまえたちがそこまで言うなら
いいけどさぁ…
records.current_English:
If you all feel that strongly, 
 I guess it's fine...

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: で、どこに住んでおられるのですか？
records.current_English: Where does she live?

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.Japanese: ロンドンじゃよ
records.current_English: London.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
分かりました
それでは、向かいましょう
records.current_English: All right. Let's head to London.

rows: I think it's a good idea. If she's
that good with a sword, she'll

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.Japanese: おい、FI！
records.current_English: Hey, FI!

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: どうしたの？
records.current_English: What is it?

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.Japanese: すっげーお宝の噂を耳にしたんだ！
records.current_English: I heard about an amazing treasure!

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: へえ？　何ていう宝なの？
records.current_English: Oh? What treasure?

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.Japanese:
『善導のステッキ』とかいう
名前らしい
records.current_English: The Guiding Staff, I think.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: 何がすごいのさ？
records.current_English: What's so special about it?

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.Japanese:
ギルドの買い取りリストに
今まで見たこともねえ高値が
付けられてたんだよ！　でも
まだ誰も見つけてねえ物らしいんだ！
records.current_English:
The Guild's buying list shows
 a price higher than anything 
 I've ever seen.
 And no one's even found it yet!

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: それで？
records.current_English: And?

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.Japanese:
だから、それを手に入れたら
それだけで大金持ちじゃねえか！
なっ、分かったらさっそく行こうぜ！
records.current_English:
We'd be rich if we found it! 
 Come on, what are we waiting for?

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: 行くって…どこに行くの？
records.current_English: Go... where?

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.Japanese:
どこって、『善導のステッキ』の
あるところさ！
決まってるじゃねえか！
records.current_English:
Where the Guiding Staff
 is, of course!

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: だから、それはどこ？
records.current_English: And where is that?

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.Japanese:
え？
…知らねえ
records.current_English: Uh... No idea.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: じゃあ、探しようがないよ？
records.current_English:
How are we supposed
 to look for it, then?

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.Japanese: …確かに
records.current_English: ...True.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
もう、しっかりしてよ
第一、そんないい加減な情報じゃ
本当にあるかどうかだって
怪しいもんだよ
records.current_English:
Come on, Clau. With a lead 
 that vague, we don't even know 
 if it's real.

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.Japanese:
…うーん、そうだな
やっぱダメか
records.current_English:
...Yeah, you're right. 
 I guess that's that.

records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.Japanese:
俺ってどうしてこう
単純なんだろうな…
records.current_English:
Why do I fall for things 
 so easily...?

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: クラウ…？
records.current_English: Clau...?

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.Japanese: …FIぼうや
records.current_English: FI, my boy...

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
あ、フリオさん
…そろそろぼうやはやめてください
records.current_English:
Oh, Julio. Could you stop
 calling me 'my boy'?

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.Japanese:
おお、すまんのう
つい、昔のくせでな
records.current_English: Oh, sorry. Old habits, you know.

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.Japanese:
その…
『善導のステッキ』のことじゃがな
records.current_English: Well... About that Guiding Staff.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
さっき、クラウが言ってた
宝のこと？
records.current_English: The treasure Clau mentioned?

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.Japanese:
どうじゃ
わしの話でも聞いてみるか？
records.current_English: Well? Want to hear what I know?

records.speaker: Player choice
records.Japanese: 聞かせてください
records.current_English: Please tell me.

records.speaker: Player choice
records.Japanese: いえ、もういいんです
records.current_English: No, I've heard enough.

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.Japanese:
…『善導のステッキ』ってのは
人を善へと導いてくれるといわれておる
宝じゃ
records.current_English:
They say the Guiding Staff guides
 people to do good.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: じゃあ、本当にあるんですか？
records.current_English: So it really exists?

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.Japanese: 言い伝えではのう
records.current_English: So legends say.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: どこにあるんだろう…？
records.current_English: Where could it be...?

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.Japanese: インドといわれておる
records.current_English: They say it is in India.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: じゃ、本当にあるんですね
records.current_English: Then it must be real.

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.Japanese: あくまでも、言い伝えじゃ
records.current_English: Remember, it's only a legend.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
そうか
あんな言い方をしちゃって…
クラウに謝らないと
records.current_English:
Oh. I shouldn't have talked to Clau
 like that. I'd better apologize.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: フリオさん、ありがとう！
records.current_English: Thank you, Julio!

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.Japanese: あっ、おい
records.current_English: Hey, wait!

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.Japanese: 行ってしまいおった
records.current_English: Gone already.

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.Japanese:
まっ、これでクラウディオのヤツも
元気が出るじゃろ。あやつが
落ち込んどると陰気くそうて
酒がまずうなるからのう
records.current_English:
That ought to cheer Claudio up.
 When he's gloomy,
 it spoils the taste of my drink.

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.Japanese:
しかし、『善導のステッキ』の
言い伝えなどすっかり忘れておったわ
FIは本当に
探す気かのう…？
records.current_English:
I'd forgotten all about the legend 
 of the Guiding Staff, though.
 Is FI really
 going to look for it?

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.Japanese:
まっ、どっちでもよい
わしゃジェナスでも誘って
１杯やるとするかの
records.current_English:
Oh well. 
 I'll see if Janus wants a drink.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
またそんなこと言って
クラウと２人して僕をだまそうって
いうんでしょ
その手には乗りませんよ
records.current_English:
Here we go again. You and Clau 
 are trying to fool me, aren't you? 
 I'm not falling for it.

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.Japanese:
はあ？
そんなこたせんわい
records.current_English: What? I'd do no such thing.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
僕を酒の肴にしようって言うんでしょ
分かってるんですから
records.current_English:
You just want something to laugh 
 at over drinks.
 I know what you're up to.

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.Japanese:
そんなこたぁせんと言うとろうが
…もう、ええわ
records.current_English:
I said I'd do no such thing! ...Oh,
 never mind.

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.Japanese:
さっきのことでクラウのヤツが
落ち込んどるから、おまえさんに
どうにかしてもらおうと思って
話しかけただけじゃ
records.current_English:
Clau's down about what just
 happened. I only came over 
 because I thought you could help.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese:
え？　そ、そうだったんですか
…すいません、フリオさん
records.current_English: Oh, th-that's why? I'm sorry, Julio.

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.Japanese:
…分かればよいのじゃ
それより、クラウを元気づけてやるが
よかろう
records.current_English:
...All right, you understand. Go on
 and cheer Clau up.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor
records.Japanese: あ、はい！
records.current_English: Oh, yes!

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.Japanese:
まったく世話が焼けるのう
それよりも…。酒の肴とか言うから
飲みたくなって
しもうたではないか
records.current_English:
What a handful. And now all that 
 talk of drinks has made me thirsty.

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.Japanese:
そうじゃ、ジェナスでも誘って
一杯やるとするか
records.current_English: I'll see if Janus wants a drink.

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.Japanese: ウシッシシシ。酒、酒っと
records.current_English: Heh heh. Time for a drink.
